source_title: Macklemore’s Free Palestine Tour gets massive welcome in Dublin, where pro-Palestinian support runs deep
source_excerpt:
DUBLIN — With roaring support from a packed crowd, Macklemore launched his Free Palestine Tour in Ireland’s capital Monday, just over a month after he was controversially dropped as Ed Sheeran ’s supporting act.
